instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and the datum lines you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the two patterned sets of subtractive cylinder cuts. For the cuts patterned around DatumLine, use a subtractive cylinder with radius 3 mm and height 26 mm, then repeat it with a 360 degree Polar Pattern containing 6 occurrences. For the cuts patterned around DatumLine001, use a subtractive cylinder with radius 4 mm and height 13 mm, then repeat it with a 360 degree Polar Pattern containing 8 occurrences. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
